stances_toward.note: Adversary is our reading (C), not a source's word. The ISS headline 'ISWAP takes aim at the state in Cameroon' (July 2021) makes the state the target; the article body was not read. No government statement calling the group a mortal enemy was read in this card. Bond grievance: an open wound from attacks on civilians and soldiers. Since is the date of the earliest source read, not the start of the conflict; press reports of 2026 raids were not used, since they came from aggregators (tier 4).
